text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "La Suisse se situe au milieu du continent européen et est entourée d’Etats membres de l’Union européenne (UE)", "gist": "Switzerland is located in the middle of the European continent and is surrounded by EU member states"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "l’UE et ses Etats membres sont de loin les premiers partenaires commerciaux de la Suisse", "gist": "The EU and its member states are by far Switzerland's main trading partners"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Une politique européenne active est ainsi essentielle du point de vue économique", "gist": "An active European policy is thus essential from an economic perspective"}, {"type": "obligation", "quote": "La Suisse a négocié différents accords bilatéraux afin de garantir un accès au marché intérieur de l’UE", "gist": "Switzerland negotiated various bilateral agreements to secure access to the EU internal market"}]}
